property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C always succeeds (call returns true) when it invokes transferFrom(address,address,uint256) on the callee using the correct selector; the mutant that uses a wrong selector (e.g. uint32) causes the callee's typed function NOT to be invoked and thus the low-level call to revert/fail for some calldata/values — so the reference never reverts but the mutant can revert for certain inputs.
change_summary: Change the selector to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) -> transferFrom(address,address,uint256) with different signature by altering bytes4 computation to a different string, causing callee to likely revert when selector mismatch.
